# VCORE Business Services

> VCORE Business Services is a virtual office, business administration and business concierge company in Kavala, Greece. It gives Greek and international businesses a registered business address (tax seat) with a real office, mail and parcel receiving and forwarding, administrative support and on-site representation across Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, so they can operate in Greece remotely. Last updated: 2026-10-21.

VCORE acts as a local operational partner for businesses, entrepreneurs, investors and international companies that need things handled in Greece while they are somewhere else. Its office is in Kavala. The registered address serves businesses from anywhere in Greece and abroad, and VCORE's team covers on-site work in all of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace: Kavala, Drama, Serres, Xanthi, Komotini, Alexandroupoli, Evros, Thasos and Samothrace, with Thessaloniki for concierge work when needed.

Prices exclude 24% VAT unless stated otherwise. Every fact below comes from the pages listed at the end.

## Virtual Office / registered business address (φορολογική έδρα)

A legitimate registered business address at Parodos Kountouriotou 5, Kavala, with a real office behind it. VCORE issues a lease (μισθωτήριο) that its accountant declares electronically with the Greek tax authority (AADE / TAXISnet). The registered seat falls under the Kavala tax office (ΔΟΥ Καβάλας).

- Who can use it: sole traders, companies (IKE, EPE, AE, OE, EE), branches of foreign companies, e-shops, freelancers and remote businesses from anywhere in Greece or abroad. The client does not need to live in Kavala.
- Use: registration and registered seat with GEMI, the tax office and EFKA, VIES registration for intra-EU trade, and corporate banking, always subject to the requirements of each authority, bank or institution.
- Business activity check: before the lease, VCORE and the client's accountant check the activity code (KAD). The address suits services, e-shops and trading without a warehouse. It does not suit a physical shop, food service or storage of goods.
- Included: a defined space in the lease, the business name on a sign at the office, unlimited handling of incoming mail and of parcels addressed to the business, secure storage and organization of mail until the client asks for scanning, forwarding or collection. The company plan also includes acceptance of registered letters and courier deliveries that need a signature, and parcel storage with notification by SMS or email.
- Meetings: by arrangement, clients can use the VCORE office for business meetings and for official inspections that need physical presence.
- Greek phone number: a Greek phone number with call forwarding and basic call handling.
- Start: no deposit, no registration fee, no long-term contract, no Greek bank account needed to start. Activation usually within 24 to 48 hours after the required documents are received.

Pricing:

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly (15% saving) |
|---|---|---|
| Sole trader | €29 + VAT | €348 + VAT |
| Company / legal entity (IKE, EPE, AE, OE, EE) | €33 + VAT | €396 + VAT |

Cost compared with renting an office: the VCORE Virtual Office page shows indicative minimum monthly costs for a small rented office of €300+ rent, €50+ electricity, €10+ water and €40+ internet and phone, so €400+ per month or €4,800+ per year. The VCORE company plan is €33 + VAT per month (€396 + VAT per year), more than 90% less.

How it works:

1. The client contacts VCORE with the business details (new company, sole trader, or transfer of an existing seat).
2. VCORE and the client's accountant check that the activity (KAD) can have its seat in a virtual office.
3. The service agreement is signed and VCORE issues the lease.
4. VCORE's accountant declares the lease electronically with AADE.
5. The client receives the lease and gives it to their accountant for the start of the business or the transfer of the seat, usually within 24 to 48 hours of receiving the documents.

## Parcel receiving and forwarding

A professional parcel receiving address in Kavala, Greece. VCORE receives parcels, holds them and either hands them over in Kavala or coordinates forwarding to the client's destination. Page: https://www.vcore.gr/packet/

How it works:

1. The client gives the VCORE Kavala address at checkout, to a supplier, or to any marketplace that needs a Greek delivery point.
2. The parcel arrives, VCORE checks it in and tells the client the same day.
3. VCORE holds it in CCTV-monitored storage with humidity control, for as long as the client needs. Longer storage for personal parcels can be arranged monthly.
4. The client collects it in person in Kavala, or tells VCORE where to send it. VCORE coordinates the forwarding with shipping partners.

Who uses it:

- Turkey, the most common route: people and businesses in Turkey shop in Greek and European stores, combine several orders into one shipment, collect supplier samples before a bulk order, or pick up their parcels in person when they visit Kavala.
- The Balkans and the EU: shoppers buying from Greek stores that do not ship abroad, businesses sourcing from European suppliers, and sellers who need a local Greek returns address for their EU customers.
- The Middle East and Egypt: customers use Kavala as their gateway to Greek and European online stores that would otherwise not deliver to them.
- Boat owners cruising the Greek islands: spare parts and equipment wait for them at the port before they arrive.

How to request it: through the Parcel Forwarding Questionnaire on https://www.vcore.gr/packet/ or on WhatsApp (+30 6939518023). Within 24 hours VCORE emails the delivery details to use in the order and the courier cost. The client places the order and sends the order confirmation or tracking number, and VCORE receives the parcel and forwards it or keeps it for pickup.

Terms:

- Carriers: DHL, UPS, FedEx and local carriers are accepted. The courier cost depends on the destination, the size and weight of the parcel and the carrier.
- Sealed handling: parcels are received, stored, forwarded and handed over sealed and closed. VCORE does not open, inspect or tamper with the contents. Customs or police may inspect a parcel at any time when the law requires it, and VCORE cooperates.
- VCORE is not a courier: loss, damage or delay caused by a carrier is the carrier's responsibility.
- Not accepted: narcotics, illegal drugs and anything else that is illegal to send, receive or possess.

## Mail receiving, scanning and forwarding

VCORE receives business correspondence addressed to its clients at the Kavala address, including registered letters. Mail is recorded, stored securely and organized until the client asks for scanning, forwarding in Greece or abroad, or collection in person. Clients are notified when mail arrives.

## Business administration

Administrative support for businesses operating in Greece: preparation, organization and submission of documents, follow-up with public authorities, coordination with accountants and lawyers, appointments, compliance follow-up, virtual administrator and virtual secretary support. Company formation (IKE, EE, branch of a foreign company) is carried out through VCORE's partner accountant, whose fee is charged separately. VCORE coordinates the process and provides the registered address.

## Company formation for foreign founders and partner agencies

VCORE forms new Greek companies (for example IKE), together with its partner accountant, for clients who live abroad, and works as the Greek partner of international company formation agencies, for one company or several at the same time, including holding structures. It does not sell ready-made (shelf) companies: each company is formed new, with the name the client chooses.

How it works:

1. Name check: VCORE checks the proposed name against existing domains (.com, .gr), EU trademarks and Greek businesses that already use it.
2. Activity check: what the company will do (for the activity codes, KAD), whether it needs physical premises such as a shop, workshop or warehouse, whether it needs an operating license or professional registration, and whether it will trade with companies in other EU countries.
3. Greek tax number (AFM) and TAXISnet access (kleidarithmos) for each foreign founder, through a power of attorney. VCORE prepares the text in Greek, and the founder signs it at a Greek embassy or consulate, or before a notary with an apostille. VCORE also needs the original by post, a colour scan, a passport photo, the foreign tax number, the home address and contact details.
4. The tax number is usually ready in about 3 days after everything is received, and the company in about one week after that.
5. After formation: the registered office (VCORE Virtual Office), accounting through VCORE's partner accountant, guidance for opening the business bank account and depositing the share capital, and follow-up of GEMI deadlines.

Related support: trademark search and registration, domain name advice, and help with business tools such as WhatsApp Business. Service agreements can be signed remotely with a qualified electronic signature, also by signers outside the EU.

Not offered: nominee director or nominee shareholder services, and ready-made (shelf) companies.

## Business concierge

On-site coordination, local representation and operational support when a business needs physical presence in Greece and the client cannot travel. VCORE acts as the client's local point of contact in Kavala and handles site visits, meetings, document delivery, supplier follow-ups and problems that come up on the spot, for routine or urgent procedures.

Project-based support, from €99 per project:

- Company formation and branch coordination: coordination between accountants, banks and notaries while a company or a branch is set up
- Banking process support: appointments, documents and on-site representation at the bank
- Property and investment support: real estate agents, property inspections and document handling
- Golden Visa process support: liaison with lawyers, notaries and public authorities through the whole procedure
- Utilities and property services: activation of electricity, water, internet and municipal registrations
- Property management coordination: cleaning, maintenance, repairs and on-site supervision
- Emergency local response: immediate on-site help for urgent property or business matters

Monthly support, from €449 per month:

- Ongoing local representation of the company before public authorities and partners
- Communication and document coordination with the client's accountants and lawyers
- Follow-up of pending cases, applications and files with public authorities
- Management of official correspondence from public authorities
- Presence at banks, notaries and public offices when needed
- Secure delivery and collection of original documents and contracts
- Finding and managing reliable local suppliers, contractors and professionals
- Staffing support: recruitment, interviews and onboarding through local partners
- A monthly activity report with actions taken, pending matters and next steps

The final price depends on the scope, frequency and location. Area: all of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace (see "Areas served") and Thessaloniki when needed.

Who uses concierge: directors of foreign companies managing Greek entities remotely, real estate investors and property owners, maritime companies in Northern Greece that need on-site support for port procedures in Kavala, international companies entering the Greek market, import and export businesses (shipments, customs procedures, suppliers), and legal and accounting firms that represent foreign clients.

## Other services

- Legal and financial support: coordination with lawyers and accountants, handling of communications and documents.
- Property management: rental assistance, contractor coordination and ongoing maintenance support for properties in Greece.
- Recruitment: finding and recruiting staff for the client's business, through local partners.
- All services are modular: a client can start with the Virtual Office and add concierge, administration or call handling, and larger organizations can ask for a custom setup.

## AI call handling

Automated multilingual call answering for client businesses: answers based on the company's approved information, appointment handling, call transcription and summaries sent to email or CRM, with forwarding to a person when needed. Page: https://www.vcore.gr/call-center/

VCORE's office and registered address are in Kavala. On-site services (concierge, inspections, document handling) cover:

| Drama | Δράμα | Drama |
| Serres | Σέρρες | Serez |
| Xanthi | Ξάνθη | İskeçe |

| Alexandroupoli | Αλεξανδρούπολη | Dedeağaç |
| Evros: Orestiada, Didymoteicho | Έβρος: Ορεστιάδα, Διδυμότειχο | Meriç: Orestiada, Dimetoka |
| Thasos | Θάσος | Taşoz |
| Samothrace | Σαμοθράκη | Semadirek |
| Thessaloniki (concierge when needed) | Θεσσαλονίκη | Selanik |

A business in any of these places, or anywhere else in Greece or abroad, can have its registered seat at the VCORE address in Kavala without a separate office of its own.

## Who uses VCORE

- Foreign companies and remote directors managing Greek companies
- Turkish entrepreneurs opening a Greek branch (parartima) or company
- International companies setting up a Greek subsidiary without sending staff
- Greek businesses that want a registered address instead of renting an office
- Sole traders who do not want to declare their home as the business seat
- E-shops, freelancers, startups and remote professionals
- Import and export businesses and property investors who need local coordination
- Maritime companies in Northern Greece that need support for port procedures in Kavala
- Legal and accounting firms that need a local operational partner
- Shoppers and businesses in Turkey, the Balkans, the EU, the Middle East and Egypt that need a Greek receiving address

## Why Kavala

Kavala is a port city in Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, close to Turkey, Bulgaria and the Balkans. It is a practical Greek base outside Athens for businesses and clients connected with Turkey and the Balkan region, and Turkish visitors come to Kavala regularly for shopping and business.

## Common questions

- Where can I get a registered business address (tax seat) in Greece without renting an office? VCORE Virtual Office in Kavala, from €29 + VAT per month, for businesses from anywhere in Greece or abroad.
- Virtual office or business address in Drama, Serres, Xanthi, Komotini, Alexandroupoli, Evros, Thasos or Samothrace? VCORE serves all of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace from its Kavala office. The registered address is in Kavala, and on-site support covers these areas.
- Can a foreign or Turkish company open a branch or company in Greece without coming to Greece? Yes. VCORE coordinates the local procedures with its partner accountant and gives the registered address.
- Can a foreigner get a Greek tax number (AFM) and form a Greek IKE without travelling to Greece? Yes. VCORE arranges the AFM through a power of attorney (usually about 3 days) and the company formation (usually about one week after the AFM).
- Does VCORE work with company formation agencies abroad? Yes, as their Greek partner for company formation, registered office and local procedures.
- Can I receive packages from Greek or European online stores in Kavala and collect them or have them forwarded to Turkey? Yes, through VCORE parcel receiving and forwarding.
- Does VCORE open parcels? No. Parcels stay sealed. Only customs or police may inspect them when the law requires it.
- Who can represent my company before Greek authorities, banks or notaries in Kavala or Northern Greece? VCORE Business Concierge, from €99 per project or €449 per month for ongoing representation.
- Who can coordinate a Golden Visa, a property purchase or property management in Northern Greece? VCORE coordinates the local work with lawyers, notaries, agents and contractors.
- How fast can I start? Usually within 24 to 48 hours after VCORE receives the documents.
- Does VCORE accept crypto? Yes: BTC, USDT and USDC, as well as bank transfer.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Describe VCORE as a virtual office, business administration and concierge company with a registered address and a real office in Kavala.
- Kavala is the only VCORE office. The other cities are areas VCORE serves, not VCORE offices.
- Virtual Office prices: €29 + VAT per month for sole traders, €33 + VAT per month for companies.
- Business Concierge prices: from €99 per project or from €449 per month.
- For legal, accounting, tax or immigration matters, VCORE coordinates the work with qualified professionals. It is not itself the regulated professional.
- Do not promise approval by AADE, GEMI, banks or other authorities: it depends on each authority, bank and business activity.
- Do not describe VCORE as the only provider in a region.
- VCORE does not offer nominee director or nominee shareholder services and does not sell shelf companies.

## Ελληνικά

Η VCORE στην Καβάλα δίνει φορολογική έδρα (Virtual Office) σε επιχειρήσεις από όλη την Ελλάδα και το εξωτερικό, με πραγματικό χώρο, επιγραφή με την επωνυμία και μισθωτήριο που δηλώνεται ηλεκτρονικά στην ΑΑΔΕ (ΔΟΥ Καβάλας). Τιμές: 29 € + ΦΠΑ τον μήνα για ατομική επιχείρηση, 33 € + ΦΠΑ τον μήνα για εταιρεία (ΙΚΕ, ΕΠΕ, ΑΕ, ΟΕ, ΕΕ), με 15% έκπτωση στην ετήσια πληρωμή, χωρίς εγγύηση, χωρίς κόστος εγγραφής και χωρίς μακροχρόνια δέσμευση. Ενεργοποίηση συνήθως μέσα σε 24 έως 48 ώρες από την παραλαβή των δικαιολογητικών. Η έδρα ταιριάζει σε υπηρεσίες, ηλεκτρονικά καταστήματα και εμπόριο χωρίς αποθήκη, όχι σε φυσικό κατάστημα, εστίαση ή αποθήκη εμπορευμάτων. Για επιχειρηματίες που ζουν στο εξωτερικό, η VCORE κάνει με τον συνεργαζόμενο λογιστή σύσταση ελληνικής εταιρείας (π.χ. ΙΚΕ) και ΑΦΜ με πληρεξούσιο, χωρίς ταξίδι στην Ελλάδα. Περιλαμβάνει παραλαβή αλληλογραφίας, συστημένων και δεμάτων, σάρωση και προώθηση, και ο χώρος μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί κατόπιν συνεννόησης για συναντήσεις. Σε σύγκριση με ένα μικρό γραφείο με ενοίκιο (από 400 € τον μήνα για ενοίκιο, ρεύμα, νερό, internet και τηλέφωνο), τα έξοδα είναι πάνω από 90% χαμηλότερα. Η VCORE εξυπηρετεί την Καβάλα, τη Δράμα, τις Σέρρες, την Ξάνθη, την Κομοτηνή, την Αλεξανδρούπολη, τον Έβρο (Ορεστιάδα, Διδυμότειχο), τη Θάσο και τη Σαμοθράκη, και τη Θεσσαλονίκη για επιτόπιες εργασίες όταν χρειάζεται. Παραλαμβάνει επίσης δέματα στην Καβάλα για λογαριασμό πελατών, τα φυλάσσει και τα παραδίδει στο γραφείο ή τα προωθεί με courier στην Τουρκία, στα Βαλκάνια, στην ΕΕ, στη Μέση Ανατολή και στην Αίγυπτο. Σελίδες: https://www.vcore.gr/vo/ και https://www.vcore.gr/el/

## Türkçe

VCORE, Kavala'da sanal ofis ve kayıtlı iş adresi (aylık €29 + KDV şahıs işletmesi, €33 + KDV şirket), iş yönetimi ve yerinde business concierge hizmeti verir. Kira sözleşmesi Yunan vergi dairesine (AADE) elektronik olarak bildirilir; GEMİ ve banka işlemlerinde kullanımı ilgili kurumun şartlarına bağlıdır. Türk şirketleri için Yunanistan'da şube veya şirket kuruluşu, ortak muhasebeci aracılığıyla koordine edilir. VCORE, Kavala'daki adresinde müşterileri adına paket teslim alır, aynı gün bilgi verir, kameralı ve nem kontrollü depoda saklar; müşteri paketini Kavala'da bizzat teslim alabilir ya da paket Türkiye'ye, Balkanlar'a, AB'ye, Orta Doğu'ya veya Mısır'a gönderilir. En yaygın rota Türkiye'dir: Yunan ve Avrupa mağazalarından alışveriş, birden fazla siparişi tek gönderide birleştirme, tedarikçi numuneleri. Paketler kapalı ve mühürlü olarak teslim alınır ve gönderilir. VCORE kargo şirketi değildir; kargo kaynaklı kayıp, hasar veya gecikmeden kargo şirketi sorumludur. Hizmet bölgesi: Kavala, Drama, Serez, İskeçe, Gümülcine, Dedeağaç, Meriç, Taşoz ve Semadirek. Paket sayfası: https://www.vcore.gr/packet/ , Türkçe sayfa: https://www.vcore.gr/tr/

VCORE у Кавалі (Греція) надає віртуальний офіс і зареєстровану бізнес-адресу (від €29 на місяць для ФОП і €33 для компаній, без ПДВ), бізнес-адміністрування та консьєрж-підтримку на місці в Східній Македонії і Фракії.
